gloss: to follow (an example), to imitate, to model after

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {倣|なら}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to follow an example, to imitate, to model after
definitions.explanation: To take someone or something as a model and act accordingly. Implies deliberate emulation of a good example or established practice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{倣|なら}う。
⟦{前例|ぜんれい}→前例：11790_zenrei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{倣|なら}って⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{他|た}→他：03381_ta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成功例|せいこうれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{倣|なら}い、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}した→導入する：16055_dounyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: Following the success of other countries, a new system was introduced.

notes:
{倣|なら}う means to imitate or model oneself after something. Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧ (to learn, to take lessons).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧)
- Pattern: 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{倣|なら}う

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{倣|なら}って: following the example of ~
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{倣|なら}い: following ~ (more formal/written)
- ⟦{前例|ぜんれい}→前例：11790_zenrei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{倣|なら}う: to follow precedent
- ⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{倣|なら}え: follow the person to the right (line-up command)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧: to learn, to study (different kanji and meaning)
- ⟦{真似|まね}る→真似る：10547_maneru⟧: to mimic, to copy (less deliberate, sometimes negative)
- {倣|なら}う: to follow an example (deliberate, positive connotation)
